name: reply-skills
description: Reply.io outbound expertise for AI agents — vendor-neutral SDR knowledge, Reply execution, and durable long-running work.

plugins.name: ai-sdr-core
plugins.description: Vendor-neutral AI SDR expertise: the SDR business-operation contract, outbound strategy and playbooks, and the guardrails that keep automated outreach safe. Provider-independent — no Reply.io knowledge required.

plugins.name: reply-adapter
plugins.description: Executes the AI SDR Core operation contract against Reply.io: the reply CLI, API v3, the MCP server, authentication and scopes, and translation of Reply-specific errors. Replaceable — swap it for another provider's adapter without touching the core.

plugins.name: agentic-runtime
plugins.description: Durable multi-session work: goals, plans, work items, checkpoints, resumability, execution reports and user memory in a plain-markdown workspace. Optional — skip it if your orchestrator already provides durable work.
